question: Compare the image formed by a simple microscope and a compound microscope in terms of magnification and nature. Give reason.

options.A: A simple microscope produces greater magnification than a compound microscope because it has only one lens.
options.B: A simple microscope uses one convex lens and forms a virtual, erect, magnified image, with limited magnification. A compound microscope uses an objective to form a magnified intermediate image and an eyepiece to magnify it further, so it gives much greater magnification in two stages.
options.C: Both microscopes form the same image with equal magnification because both use convex lenses.
options.D: A compound microscope forms only a real image, whereas a simple microscope forms only an inverted image.
